response.title: which power station runs a mini split the most hours
response.answer:
For running a mini-split air conditioner or heat pump for the most hours, the best portable power station is generally the one with the largest expandable battery capacity, not necessarily the highest wattage output.

The key specifications are:

Battery capacity (kWh): Determines how many hours your mini-split can run.

Continuous AC output (W): Must support the mini-split's electrical demand.

240V support: Important if your mini-split requires 208–230V power.

Expandable batteries: Can extend runtime from hours to several days.

A typical 9,000–12,000 BTU inverter mini-split might consume 300–1,000 watts while running, depending on outdoor temperature, insulation, and thermostat settings.
